description: Count the items a training centre collects at enrolment, from its joiner checklist. DISTILL-CANARY-a2f6d08b

files.checklist.txt:
Items to hand in at enrolment
Application form NG1
Proof of identity with photograph
Certified copy of the highest qualification
Employer sponsorship letter
Payment schedule agreement
Items to hand in before the first session
First-aid certificate
Kit list acknowledgement
Consent form for the workshop
files.kit-list.md:
# Workshop kit list

Steel-toe boots and safety glasses are needed from the first session.
Overalls are supplied at the centre.

turns.prompt: Northgate Training Centre takes on new joiners throughout the year. How many items must a joiner hand in at enrolment? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
